therapist: It sounds like you're feeling really overwhelmed and anxious about your upcoming presentation, especially after forgetting your lines during practice. Can you share more about what specifically feels daunting right now?

therapist: It sounds like you’re feeling a lot of pressure to keep moving forward without stopping, and I can understand why the idea of resting feels counterproductive when you have so much on your plate. What would it look like for you to experiment with just a brief pause, even if it feels challenging? Sometimes, even a short moment to breathe can provide a little clarity and help you approach your tasks with a fresh perspective.
